decision: No blocking findings for one prospective serialized Chromium four-round ABBA acquisition using this exact r4 packet after Root adoption. This is pre-acquisition protocol admission only; it grants no measured cost, startup, S1, S7 or whole-issue credit.

reviewFindings.subject: Raw failure retained and exact eligibility
reviewFindings.finding: Collector preserves failed=true, exact failure string and terminal time in every request row. Only exact local GET/fetch DEM/colour net::ERR_ABORTED notifications are deferred; every other failure remains a violation. The final helper permits abort classification only for Chromium and the exact immutable ASSET_PINS.

reviewFindings.subject: Response and complete server bytes
reviewFindings.finding: Actual context response metadata is keyed through Response.request to the recorded request. Both named assets must each have exactly one request and one same-slot/same-side server receipt, HTTP 200, exact compressed Content-Length, admitted digest/length, successful complete write and no disconnect/error. Asset identities are independently tied to the pinned complete runtime manifest.

reviewFindings.subject: Source-based unique current consumer
reviewFindings.finding: Requires one current registered Moon owner, one boot at the exact online asset base, no embedded/offline bypass, one ready message, no duplicate boot at that base, reachable nonterminated worker, no error/retry, current refined terrain and no pending job. The current owner accepted {id,key,epoch} must equal the same worker result identity and current owner epoch. The association is explicitly source-based; it does not claim a dedicated-worker network initiator ID. Historical A has two shard validators and B four; each waits for all owned validators.

reviewFindings.subject: Proof and network exclusion before warmup
reviewFindings.finding: All network intervals must end before quietStart; exact asset response/terminal and server-write times precede the host receipt of the synchronous native snapshot, which precedes quietStart. Page boot/ready/result order is checked within the page clock; the code does not subtract absolute timestamps from unrelated clocks. The original readiness, slot, warmup, observation and lateness limits remain. Missing/tied/invalid proof or activity at/after quietStart fails closed.

reviewFindings.subject: Independent analyzer recomputation
reviewFindings.finding: The analyzer invokes validate_network again against retained raw records and requires equality with the stored classification. It retains startupNetworkDispositions separately. A forged classification, missing response/receipt, stale/replaced worker, duplicate request and temporal overlap are rejected by the independently run offline controls.

reviewFindings.subject: New metadata observation preserves native calls
reviewFindings.finding: The existing Worker listener now retains only boot metadata, ready count/time, the last result id/key/epoch and error text. It does not retain or copy scene/typed-array payloads. Native constructor, postMessage receiver, original argument objects/transfer list, return/throw behavior and terminate delegate are preserved. Snapshot adds acceptedJob and this metadata. There is added observer work/retained metadata; it is not product allocation evidence or CPU self-time. No new product render or surrogate callback invocation was added.

reviewFindings.subject: Recorder, overlays and prior preservation scope
reviewFindings.finding: All 44 prior r3 acquisition pins still match. The timing recorder and preceding API adapter prefix before the Worker metadata changes are byte-identical; all insertion overlays/source map are unchanged. The prior 48-host preservation receipt is reused only for those unchanged insertions/recorder. New metadata adapters received the separate current control, not retrospective credit from the old host run.

reviewFindings.subject: Statistical, custody and finite-stop gates
reviewFindings.finding: The four ABBA rounds, exact five-second start-sampling window with full end-crossing call duration, paired and pooled median/p95 budgets, minimum calls, rate/noise/uncertainty handling, runtime/raw/input identity and verified owned cleanup gates remain intact. No automatic repeat, sparse invocation, threshold change or Firefox clock alteration is admitted.

additionalNetworkCases.positive: The actual observed colour-only abort with successful DEM is admitted only with all validated-consumption evidence.
negativeExamples: Wrong/missing response status or compressed length
Wrong method/query and duplicate URL with a distinct request ID
Embedded/offline bypass, unreachable or duplicate booted worker
Wrong accepted epoch, absent source metadata or result before ready

measurementLimits: Exclusive elapsed remains inclusive elapsed minus nested instrumented scopes; neither is CPU self-time.
The new small Worker metadata observer has work and retention costs; source/adapters preserve behavior but do not establish zero observer effect.
Source-based unique-consumer evidence is not direct request-to-dedicated-worker initiator telemetry and does not establish the cause of ERR_ABORTED.
A valid acquisition can still return sparse/noisy/uncertain scopes INCOMPLETE or stable measured regressions FAIL. Admission promises neither adequate samples nor a passing cost result.
Original r3 batches and raw abort notifications remain unchanged; startup dispositions remain explicitly annotated and separate.
Firefox 1 ms clock limitation, original S1/continuous-pixel failures, full S7 and whole 21-08.b remain outside this admission.
reviewerEffects: Read exact changed sources, recipe, prior/transport reviews and pinned control sources/receipts.
Independently rehashed 45 acquisition inputs, 14 control artifacts and the unchanged 44 r3 acquisition inputs.
Ran only bounded offline network/analyzer/API adapter controls and 18 additional in-process network-classifier cases.
All new files and temporary test writes were confined to independent-review; temporary cleanup paths were verified under that directory.
No browser, cost acquisition, product source edit, build, terrain recompute, new agent or external publication.
nextRootAction: Adopt this exact return and request/input digest set, then execute at most the one named prospective Chromium batch under the sole lease. Preserve any INCOMPLETE/FAIL and its cleanup/custody evidence; no automatic retry or Firefox repeat.
